mapper.select: SELECT id, id_site AS idSite, alert_type AS alertType, metric, operator, threshold, unit, description FROM weather_alert_configuration WHERE id_site = #{siteId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO weather_alert ( id_site, id_alert_configuration, weather_event, reading, unit, threshold, forecast_date, enabled ) VALUES ( #{idSite}, #{idAlertConfiguration}, #{weatherEvent}, #{reading}, #{unit}, #{threshold}, #{forecastDate}, #{enabled} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reading = VALUES(reading), unit = VALUES(unit), threshold = VALUES(threshold), forecast_date = VALUES(forecast_date), enabled = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT id, id_site AS idSite, id_alert_configuration AS idAlertConfiguration, weather_event AS weatherEvent, reading, unit, threshold, forecast_date AS forecastDate, enabled FROM weather_alert WHERE id_site = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE
